title: NODE — The Historian's Garage

features.name: block letters in thick black texta
features.desc-on-touch: I WAS SAD I HAD NO SHOES UNTIL I MET A MAN WHO HAD NO FEET. On corrugated cardboard above a bench with a clamp and a wireless.

features.name: a milk crate beneath a naked globe
features.desc-on-touch: Somewhere to sit and read while the mower runs. The shadow boards hold tools with sturdy wooden handles.

features.name: a paperback about fighters from the region
features.desc-on-touch: Elias Shore had to be promoted as a Cuban boxer, because his birthright as a First Nations man was not palatable with local sensibilities at the time. Posters said Eli Shore. Newspapers, Ellis Shaw. Promoters sold him as Elías del Puerto.

features.name: a certificate beneath a heavy hand plane
features.desc-on-touch: A name in faint script along the bottom. The original went to the dump with everything else. No database holds it. This render does not hold it either: the line is left blank on purpose.

inscription: I will protect it, I told Katita. You will fight for it, Katita said

file.name: Fighters_of_the_Region.txt
file.note: A local historian's paperback, written on milk crates. One name is not in it.
